issues.title: Segmentation: completed S0 recovery and dev-selected u18000 checkpoint
issues.body:
Implements the Fashionpedia eight-class Mask2Former pipeline through resumable S0 training, complete-dev checkpoint selection, candidate export/cache and offline coverage entry points. The latest run fixes bounded AMP overflow handling and restores all six states from u18000 without extending the 20000-update budget. Formal S0 training and the eight full dev250 evaluations are now complete.

### Measured result

| Update | Mask AP (0-100) | AP small |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 3000 (saved prior report) | 50.560314 | 7.581145 |
| 6000 | 52.508257 | 8.830062 |
| 8000 | 56.580710 | 8.107304 |
| 10000 | 55.952178 | 8.594330 |
| 12000 | 57.018114 | 7.269056 |
| 14000 | 63.053691 | 10.171980 |
| 16000 | 63.366814 | 10.766518 |
| **18000 (selected)** | **63.579160** | **10.738919** |
| 20000 | 63.559531 | 10.664106 |

The preregistered maximum full-dev mask AP rule selects u18000, improving on the old u3000 by 13.018847 AP points. The approximately 0.02-point difference from u20000 is not evidence of significant degradation. All eight classes improve over u3000; skirt +18.6566, outerwear +16.2126, AP-small +3.1578. These are seed42 dev-selection results, not final test or end-to-end language results.

The selected file is the original saved `segmentation-s0-20000-20261115-r01/train/checkpoint_018000.pth`, SHA256 `207e2dbe1dcc8b9d0ef936d683d25af33c210347e34506914bbf6dad3426ee01`. The new u20000 checkpoint remains available as the latest complete recovery state.

### Recovery and validation

- Execution source: `e6637ffab4e7f3a0871810043fee00b586629d12`; results/documentation commit: `32845db`. Model, optimizer, scheduler, scaler, sampler and RNG restored exactly at the checkpoint boundary. Seed42, batch2, LSJ768, AdamW, LR schedule and frozen train5000/dev250 are unchanged.
- Completed 2000 successful updates, 18001–20000. At update 19315, the same images [27781, 30281] and backbone parameter again produced a non-finite gradient at scale512. One failed attempt skipped the optimizer and scheduler; scale512→256, sampler/RNG/model buffers restored, and the same effective batch succeeded on replay. No successful-update number was skipped.
- Only successful-update loss/gradient records are finite; the overflow is preserved separately. The old/new 1314-update prefix is not bitwise identical, so full-state restoration is not claimed to guarantee identical GPU trajectories.
- Same-budget source repair pins parent checkpoint/config/source, the target source and exact changed files. Ordinary strict resume and the original per-identity selector remain strict. An audited cross-repair selector verifies identities, hashes, unchanged AP implementation and the full dev denominator.
- Added validation only: 13 CPU boundary tests plus one tiny real-CUDA GradScaler regression (0.852 seconds test body), followed by the actual successful production recovery. No old smoke, COCO reload or redundant stability suite.
- Reused seven saved checkpoints; evaluated each of the eight points on all 250 dev images using the existing FP32 top100 COCO mask AP protocol. The old u3000 report was reused without inference.
- One locked run, 2026-11-15 17:32:13–18:03:06 HKT: 1853.49 seconds / 30.89 minutes, below the three-hour hard limit. No automatic restart or extension. Peak allocated/reserved training CUDA memory: 4.397/5.168 GiB. Postflight GPU0 MiB/0%, no compute process or active coordination record; data disk 158.04 GiB free.
- Current team branches, PRs, handoffs and server resources were checked before execution. No teammate workspace, environment or process was changed. Original failed-run evidence remains failed; the recovery has a separate completed run.
- Transferred evidence archive and all 45 manifest member hashes verified. Registry records one completed training run and eight actual dev evaluations, without inventing a new u3000 run.

### Remaining delivery

Existing u3000 dev250 candidate cache and 0.3/0.5/0.7 trial packages remain their original version. New u18000 candidate packages were **not** generated in this stage; that is the next segmentation delivery. Formal matched coverage/threshold selection still needs accepted language dev and is independent of segmentation AP. No final test, M2 completion, teammate personal acceptance or further GPU work is claimed. Keep this PR draft and unmerged.

### Evidence

- [Completed recovery, metrics, comparison and next delivery](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/s0_recovery20000_20261115.md)
- [Overall nine-point selection](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/evidence/s0_recovery20000_20261115/overall_selection.json)
- [Run metadata and artifact hashes](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/evidence/s0_recovery20000_20261115/run_metadata.json)
- [Actual overflow record](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/evidence/s0_recovery20000_20261115/train/amp_overflow.jsonl)
- [Comparison figure](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/evidence/s0_recovery20000_20261115/s0_dev_comparison.png)
- [Team status](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/status.md)
- [Existing u3000 candidate delivery](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/segmentation/pilot-adapter-v1/docs/handoffs/segmentation/real_candidates_dev250_20261114.md)

issues.title: Grounding: SigLIP baselines, data acceptance and bounded M1 weak-label trial
issues.body:
接入 B 发布的 schema-3 候选、共享查询解析和统一评价器，提供锁定版本的 SigLIP 2 编码、冻结特征缓存、B1/B2 预测与规则覆盖率。新增只读流式数据验收，以及显式 train-only 的 M1 弱标注短试训入口；模型推理仅接收完整查询和候选，不读取人工答案字段。

依赖 #4：本 PR 暂以 data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation 为 base，只展示 grounding 的改动；请先审核该接口依赖，再按团队流程调整 base。未合并 main。

实际验证：
- B 数据环境的 111 项联合测试通过；grounding 环境的 24 项专项测试通过（18 项接口测试有重叠）。数据构建依赖 NumPy 2，不能把 B 的构建测试直接当作 NumPy 1.26 模型环境测试；环境差异已记录。
- 6 个真实发布包：32,574 个哈希条目、25,715 份候选/COCO/源 mask 比对、逐图解码裁剪、查询引用、跨分区 ID/hash/group 隔离通过；计数含语言子集重复。
- 同一34条 accepted train 查询：B0 12/34（复现），B1 18/34，B2 22/34。B2 lambda=1为事先固定诊断值，未用train选参。完美/空输出/不完整预测等独立评价控制通过；B1/B2纯缓存重放完全一致。
- M1：1000图/3160条机器描述，冻结编码器，seed42固定5轮；同训练弱标签拟合78.07%→83.96%，检查点重放一致。未声称泛化提升；正式dev尚无accepted查询，M2和其他种子未运行。

交接与完整命令：docs/handoffs/grounding/accepted_baselines_and_weak_trial_20261112.md；小型证据索引已提交。数据、权重、缓存、凭据均不在PR内。

issues.title: data_eval: reviewed pilot, evaluation core and large dataset drafts
issues.body:
项目需要统一、可追溯的数据和评价接口，避免试点标签、机器初标与正式测试结果混用。本 PR 汇总 data_eval 的真实数据转换、盲审与修订流程、共享规则解析器、B0 和统一评价核心，并交付版本化的大型数据包。

- 分割数据：5,000 train / 250 dev / 400 held-out test 图。保持官方边界，源 mask 不改写，validation 使用独立 ID 命名空间；哈希、资源地址及含镜像 pHash 保守分组。
- 语言数据：1,000 张训练图、1,580 组中英配对（3,160 条）；dev 116 图、145 组（290 条）。CPU 弱标注加有记录的 Codex 视觉修订，全部保持 needs_revision，新增 accepted 为 0；原小包 17 组 / 34 条 accepted 保留。
- 初标使用保守颜色条件、源纹样和几何；未知属性放弃判断。修订保留原文和证据，35 个按页审核页面不嵌入目标答案。accepted-only 正式评价门禁保持不变。

验证：远端独立 CPU 环境 93 项测试通过；五个包通过 schema/几何/hash 检查、独立 pycocotools 源 mask 逐像素一致性和候选裁剪检查；发布后逐文件 SHA256 核对。分割/训练查询/dev 查询分别视觉抽查 64/64/31 个目标；这不是全量质量认证。无 GPU 使用或模型训练。

限制：机器训练文件只供明确选择弱标注实验的输入；dev 仍有 134 张待补写，所有新增语言待人工审核。最终测试没有生成机器语言答案；新大包消费方验收、人工独立测试描述及三方正式冻结未完成。GT 试点诊断不是正式 dev/test 成绩。

详细路径、数据 hash、验证和下一步：[大型数据交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/large_dataset_20261112.md)；[P3 交接](https://github.com/rickyliuchunyu/comp4471-fashion-grounding/blob/data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation/docs/handoffs/data_eval/p3_reviewed_baseline_20261112.md)。大型图片、标注输出和审核包保留在服务器共享数据盘，不提交 Git。

issues.title: Add visually grounded bilingual drafts and blind human review
issues.body:
为训练语言数据增加看图初标与独立审核流程：9 张图、18 组语义描述（36 条中英文），外观/空间/组合各 6 组，12 组具有真实同类竞争。accepted 仍为 0。

自动筛出的 9 张新图中，6 张疑似将同一件衣物的可见区域拆成多个 annotation，已从本批语言包隔离；源 mask 未修改。旧 6 组分歧保留修改建议及答案暴露记录，尚未裁决。

审核页使用短编号和 mask 裁剪卡片，载荷不包含参考答案；支持文字修改、质量检查、暂存和 JSON 导出。审计保存改写、目标分歧及已暴露答案信息，不自动升级 accepted。

验证：AutoDL data_eval 独立 CPU 环境 35 项测试通过，59 个 mask 与官方源逐像素一致，59 个裁剪有效，schema/hash 检查及 pip check 通过。JS 使用 QuickJS DOM stub 验证交互，未做真实浏览器视觉/下载自动化测试。未使用 GPU。

共享包与复现命令见 docs/handoffs/data_eval/grounded_query_review_20261112.md。人工审核、旧分歧裁决、消费方验收仍待完成；B0/共享解析器/统一模型评价器尚未实现。接续 PR #1。

issues.title: Add data_eval pilot validation and human review auditing
issues.body:
Adds Fashionpedia pilot conversion, GT validation and a repeatable human review audit. Conflicting selections and disclosed answers remain separate; drafts are never automatically promoted to accepted.

Validated on AutoDL in wkq's isolated Python 3.10 CPU environment: 19 tests, existing contract fixtures, pip check, 20 images, 145 source-identical masks/crops and 218 package file checksums. Shared package: `/root/autodl-tmp/fashion-grounding/shared/processed/fp_pilot20_v2`.

Audit: 32 target agreements, 6 disagreements and 2 disclosed-answer groups. Accepted=0. The 34 category-only and 6 spatial groups are for interface checks; richer language data and human adjudication remain pending. B0, unified model evaluation and actual model consumer validation are not implemented by this change. No GPU training or optional extensions.

See `docs/handoffs/data_eval/remote_pilot_review_20261112.md` for reproduction and evidence. Data, original human reviews and credentials are not committed.

data.body:
接入 B 发布的 schema-3 候选、共享查询解析和统一评价器，提供锁定版本的 SigLIP 2 编码、冻结特征缓存、B1/B2 预测与规则覆盖率。新增只读流式数据验收，以及显式 train-only 的 M1 弱标注短试训入口；模型推理仅接收完整查询和候选，不读取人工答案字段。

依赖 #4：本 PR 暂以 data-eval/p3-baseline-evaluation 为 base，只展示 grounding 的改动；请先审核该接口依赖，再按团队流程调整 base。未合并 main。

实际验证：
- B 数据环境的 111 项联合测试通过；grounding 环境的 24 项专项测试通过（18 项接口测试有重叠）。数据构建依赖 NumPy 2，不能把 B 的构建测试直接当作 NumPy 1.26 模型环境测试；环境差异已记录。
- 6 个真实发布包：32,574 个哈希条目、25,715 份候选/COCO/源 mask 比对、逐图解码裁剪、查询引用、跨分区 ID/hash/group 隔离通过；计数含语言子集重复。
- 同一34条 accepted train 查询：B0 12/34（复现），B1 18/34，B2 22/34。B2 lambda=1为事先固定诊断值，未用train选参。完美/空输出/不完整预测等独立评价控制通过；B1/B2纯缓存重放完全一致。
- M1：1000图/3160条机器描述，冻结编码器，seed42固定5轮；同训练弱标签拟合78.07%→83.96%，检查点重放一致。未声称泛化提升；正式dev尚无accepted查询，M2和其他种子未运行。

交接与完整命令：docs/handoffs/grounding/accepted_baselines_and_weak_trial_20261112.md；小型证据索引已提交。数据、权重、缓存、凭据均不在PR内。
